summary: Reliability and hardening per the approved plan: standard JSON errors everywhere, 503 on link-store outage, failed-token throttle, 16 KiB body limit, security headers, loopback-only Actuator metrics

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.4.5</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>url-shortener</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>url-shortener</name>
    <description>URL shortener service: short links, redirects, expiry, token-authorized deletion</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>17</java.version>
        <bucket4j.version>8.14.0</bucket4j.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <!-- health and metrics on a loopback-only management port (FR14, FR15) -->
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.bucket4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>bucket4j_jdk17-core</artifactId>
            <version>${bucket4j.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

spring:
  application:
    name: url-shortener
  datasource:
    # File-based H2 so links and tombstones survive restarts (NFR4). No external infrastructure.
    url: jdbc:h2:file:${shortener.data-dir}/shortener;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE
    username: sa
  jpa:
    open-in-view: false
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate   # Flyway owns the schema; Hibernate only checks it matches the entities
  flyway:
    enabled: true

server:
  port: 8080

management:
  # Operators only: a separate listener bound to loopback, unreachable from the public interface (FR15).
  server:
    port: 8081
    address: 127.0.0.1
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,metrics

shortener:
  data-dir: ./data
  rate-limit:
    creates-per-minute: 20
    failed-token-attempts-per-minute: 10
  max-api-body-bytes: 16384
  code-length: 8

decisions.choice: Existing ApiException codes stay authoritative; only framework errors (via their own status and headers) and unexpected exceptions are translated, with fixed messages
decisions.rationale: Reviewer change request: the existing 400/401/403/404/409/410/429 contract must not change

decisions.choice: Counted in LinkController after the service reports invalid_token, keyed by getRemoteAddr(), one shared rolling 60 s window for stats and delete; the 11th wrong token gets 429; valid and missing tokens bypass it
decisions.rationale: FR10 and the owner's decisions; never pre-rejecting means a valid owner cannot be locked out

decisions.choice: Only the redirect's required link lookup maps resource-failure, transient and cannot-create-transaction exceptions to 503 service_unavailable with Retry-After 5; click recording stays best-effort
decisions.rationale: FR6 as scoped to redirects; keeps ClickFailureIsolationTest's guarantee intact

decisions.choice: A filter on /api/** counts received bytes (stops at limit+1) and replays the buffered body; Content-Length above the limit is rejected early
decisions.rationale: FR12; a missing or false Content-Length cannot bypass it (verified with a chunked 20 KB request)

decisions.choice: A highest-precedence filter that also runs on error dispatches, registered on the management child context through ManagementContextConfiguration as well
decisions.rationale: FR13 says every response; the management server is a separate context with its own filter chain

decisions.choice: One Micrometer timer shortener.redirects tagged only by outcome (302/404/410/5xx/other): its count is the outcome count and its timing the latency
decisions.rationale: FR14; low cardinality and no codes, IPs or destinations, so no privacy or hot-path cost

decisions.choice: Port 8081 bound to 127.0.0.1 exposing only health and metrics; verified unreachable from the LAN address
decisions.rationale: FR15; operators only, without adding an authentication system

decisions.choice: application.yml gains management and new shortener limits; properties are configurable so tests can use ephemeral ports
decisions.rationale: Modifying existing config is a policy-gated change, expected here
